rv.q: Although all the material is part of Lynette's personal and searing life story, she didn't quite figure out how to connect the dots between those two essential elements of the musical.
Lynnette's story is vulnerable and moving, with music expressing a unique mix of angst and rage combined with a desire to grow and heal.
Morris and Jacinda Ratcliffe take us through visitation to Reception with great energy and verve.
